limits: Instantaneous stiff fault source is an imposed sensitivity, not a full LMR51635 failure model.
Zero-ESR lumped output capacitance, fixed effective inductance, ideal switch opens instantaneously at total imposed delay.
No stray feedthrough, clamp, gate dynamics, saturation, startup, SOA, control-loop stability or actual consumer acceptance.
3.6V is a working normal-operation ceiling, not an assertion of a common absolute maximum.
L before the disconnect requires a separate upstream energy/clamp path; its energy is not silently transferred to the protected output.
Capacitance values are imposed effective values, not a qualified new capacitor bank.
